loading.basis: 4 truck loading bays: 2 for the data centre's 1,771 m² of floor (hall, UPS and battery rooms 1,187 m² plus support rooms at 33 %, the safer reading). Plus 1 for the refuge, warming shelter (365 m², row 5.2.3: one for each 2,800 m²; which programs fall in this row is our reading ?). Plus 1 for the outpatient clinic (605 m², row 5.2.9 Office Uses, Class B: a Health Care Office is an Office Use, our reading). Each class of use is counted separately and the counts added (Parking By-law s. 5.1, Multi-Use Developments). The by-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The data centre uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1).

rules.text: Loading: 4 bays inside the building (169 m² of ground storey; Architecture default, as the test fits draw it). Ratios takes this floor out of the ground; Arrange draws it on the ground storey at the rear end of the building (drawing choice).

Outpatient clinic: 605 m² on 3 storeys of about 202 m² each (it does not fit on one floor here), with two stairs and a lift (plan layer; their floor comes out of the program's, net floor in the plan). A clinic may sit on upper floors (J.B. 4 Nov 2026).

Outpatient clinic: its upper floors are drawn 4 m apart (the I-3 minimum), not at the data centre's 6 m storeys, because 3 storeys at that height pass the 18 m limit; floors that do not line up share no door (drawing choice ?).
Generator test: one set about 75.7 dB(A) at 9.1 m, within the 80 dB(A) limit (By-law 6555 s. 4.1(c); 78 dB(A) at 7 m, maker claim; our arithmetic).

Loading: no street or lane at the rear or sides, so a 6.1 m drive runs from the front street along the side to the dock; 6.1 m of it lies in the required side yard: a flagged option, the Director may allow a reduced side yard for loading and vehicular access (I-3 3.1.2.16) (drawing choice; Edmonton gives no aisle width, 6.1 m used ?).
Loading dock: trucks reach it by the 6.1 m drive from the front street along the side (6.1 m aisle; geometry only, turning not checked ?).
Refuge in I-3: conditional (Community Centre or Neighbourhood House; Social Service Centre).
Refuge: A-2, 2 h fire separation from the data centre (F-2).
Refuge: keep-apart rules not checked here: generators (no distance in the source).
Warming shelter in I-3: conditional (Social Service Centre (day); overnight: no listed use ?).
Warming shelter: A-2, 2 h fire separation from the data centre (F-2).
Warming shelter: keep-apart rules not checked here: generators (no distance in the source).
Outpatient clinic in I-3: conditional (Health Care Office).
Outpatient clinic: keep-apart rules not checked here: generators (no distance in the source).
